publicationRule: No candidate section may be published as final while mandatory facts or legal review are missing.

candidateRequirements: publisher/operator identity according to actual legal form
missing: final production host/legal entity and required contact facts

candidateScope: governing-law/jurisdiction wording only after legal review
dependencies: final moderation role and DSA qualification

consumerSalesTerms.reason: No canonical paid offer, price, seller, provider or final digital product/service classification exists.
candidateRequirements: withdrawal/right-of-withdrawal information and standard form where applicable

baselineCandidate.distanceContractCoolingOff: 14 days candidate baseline for covered distance consumer contracts
baselineCandidate.refundTiming: candidate baseline: refund no later than 14 days after being informed of withdrawal where applicable
baselineCandidate.refundMethod: candidate baseline: same payment method unless consumer agrees otherwise without extra fees

digitalDistinction: digital service/subscription and one-off digital content may follow different withdrawal rules
do not treat starting a subscription/service as automatic loss of withdrawal right
for online digital content not supplied on tangible medium, loss of withdrawal right requires the legally required explicit consent/acknowledgement conditions where applicable
any proportional payment for service already performed requires the applicable legal conditions
implementationNeeds: export/retrieval handling for user-created content where applicable

baseline: e-commerce services are within the European Accessibility Act scope from 28 June 2025 when applicable
do not assume exemption solely from current project size
validate any microenterprise or disproportionate-burden exemption against actual legal facts
automated accessibility tests do not prove legal conformity

prohibitedAssumptions: Do not invent company/legal entity details.
Do not publish a canonical price or subscription.
Do not claim withdrawal exceptions before product classification and required consent flow are proven.
Do not claim accessibility exemption without actual entity facts and legal review.
Do not use dark patterns, hidden cancellation or forced consent.
Do not merge privacy notice, legal notices, CGU and CGV into one opaque wall if separate presentation improves clarity.
